title: Stay in Nashville Like a Local!
description:
Hi!  Welcome to Nashville!  This Airbnb is centrally located between downtown and the airport, and it is very close to The Opry.  The home is a 15-minute Lyft drive to Lower Broadway and less than a 5 minute drive to the airport.  The home offers lots of privacy and comfort.  We hope you enjoy it as much as we have!

The space
Be sure to try out the record player!  And you can also plug your phone into the record player to listen to the music on your phone if you like.  The Airbnb does not have cable television, but it does have Netflix!

Other things to note
We will provide a starter kit of supplies that includes 2 rolls of toilet paper, 1 roll of paper towels, trash bags, etc.  We will also provide shampoo, soap, dishwashing liquid, and other various household supplies to ensure guests have all the basic conveniences for a comfortable experience!  However, guests will want to plan to purchase additional supplies they may need during their stay.  There are 2 grocery stores within walking distance of the property and multiple small department stores that can be reached by walking within minutes if additional supplies are necessary.
